No quality gate was run."); reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-001.md, "Done-When self-check" ("independent quality-gate verdict still pending")
findings.note: tasks.md T-001 Done-When bullet 'TDD evidence' requires 'An independent quality-gate verdict records PASS, with a named second reviewer distinct from the implementing agent.' No such verdict exists anywhere in the bundle, and the Default-FAIL verification contract itself records two REQUIRED checks as passes:false. By the contract's own semantics T-001 is not gate-ready; its comment concedes this ('This makes the contract fail overall on this required check, which is the correct outcome'). The placeholder-scan failure additionally carries no human acceptance on record, which the scanner's own message names as the only alternative to fixing each finding.

findings.ref: specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/verification/T-001/security-review.md (header 'Reviewed artifact: specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/drafts/apply-protected-files.ps1'; addendum: 'The reviewed artifact no longer exists ... No digest of the reviewed bytes was recorded', 'Three substantive changes landed after this review, all of which touch boundaries it assessed' (9997091c, 75fe25a3, 2499e813), 'It does not re-issue the verdict ... the 2026-08-08 PASS should be read as scoped to a predecessor artifact, not to what ships'); tasks.md T-001 Done-When 'Security review'; design.md Protected-File Statement ('A future implementation task authors and has this runner security-reviewed before this feature's own human-copy batch is ever applied')
findings.note: T-001's Done-When 'Security review' bullet and design.md's Protected-File Statement both require the shipped runner to be security-reviewed before it is used. The only review on record covers a deleted predecessor artifact, records no digest of the bytes it reviewed, and is explicitly disclaimed by its own addendum as not applying to the shipped runner (human-copy/apply-protected-files.ps1, sha256 8fc01f58...). For a Risk: high / Security-Sensitive: true protected-file writer this Done-When item is unmet.

findings.ref: reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-001.md, section '## Four-target / fifth-target contradiction (unchanged from the prior resume's own recommendation)' ('This session keeps the four-target interpretation: MANIFEST.sha256 and $Script:DeclaredTargets stay at exactly four entries; .github/workflows/test.yml is staged as a fifth file ... but is applied by a plain, human-reviewed cp (never through the runner) and must be removed from human-copy/ before the runner is ever invoked'), against the same report's '## Outputs' table (five staged payload digests), human-copy/MANIFEST.sha256 (five lines, incl. .github/workflows/test.yml), human-copy/apply-protected-files.ps1 ($Script:DeclaredTargets, five entries), specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/README.md ('Why .github/workflows/test.yml is a declared payload target (resolved 2026-08-21)'), requirements.md AC-010/AC-031, design.md Protected-File Statement dated note 2026-08-24, investigation.md INV-022
findings.note: The implementation report -- a declared artifact of this task -- still carries as its standing recommendation the superseded four-target interpretation, instructing an operator to apply the R-10-protected .github/workflows/test.yml with a bare unverified `cp` and to delete it from human-copy/ before running the runner. That is exactly the route INV-022 and security-spec.md's B5 row identify as forbidden by AC-031 and design.md's Protected-File Statement ('never a bare `cp`'), and following it would also break the delivered suite (TEST-000d hard-fails when the staged workflow is absent) and make Test-ExactSet report a missing declared target. The section is never retracted and contradicts the shipped runner, MANIFEST.sha256, README.md, requirements.md AC-010/AC-031 and design.md simultaneously.

findings.note: The assertions iterate $DeclaredTargets (five) but their pass messages still say 'four', so the GREEN logs that stand as AC-010/AC-031 evidence misdescribe the target count actually verified. Cosmetic in effect, but it is the same four-versus-five drift the 2026-08-21 widening exists to close, left standing in the evidence a reviewer reads.
